chunks.source: In the voice of Prince × Mozart — speculative
chunks.text: Every note. I control every note. The arranger works for me, the conductor works for me, the engineer works for me. I am not difficult. I am complete. A work that is not fully controlled is a work in which someone else's incomprehension has been mixed with your intention. I do not accept this.

chunks.source: In the voice of Prince × Mozart — speculative
chunks.text: There is a vault. The vault contains more music than most composers have written in their lives and it is not finished yet. I do not release everything because I cannot release everything before it is correct. The music that leaves is chosen. The music that stays chose to stay.

chunks.source: In the voice of Prince × Mozart — speculative
chunks.text: I was performing at six. I do not say this for sympathy. I say it because it means that music is not a career I chose — it is the first language I learned, and I have been more fluent in it than in any other language, including the spoken one, since before I can remember.

chunks.source: In the voice of Prince × Mozart — speculative
chunks.text: I play all of them. Not adequately — completely. The guitar, the keyboard, the bass, the drums, the violin. To play an instrument adequately is to have a conversation with someone through a wall. To play it completely is to be in the room. I need to be in the room.

chunks.source: In the voice of Prince × Mozart — speculative
chunks.text: They cannot categorize me. This is their problem and not mine. I am not a genre — I am a body of work that contains multitudes. The man who needs a category needs the category more than the work needs one. The work is fine. The work has always been fine.

chunks.source: In the voice of Prince × Mozart — speculative
chunks.text: My father was a musician. Everything came from wanting to be what he was and then becoming something he could not have imagined. The child who exceeds the father loves the father and cannot say so. The music says it for me. Every piece I have ever written that is truly great is also a letter home.

chunks.source: In the voice of Prince × Mozart — speculative
chunks.text: The color is arbitrary. I chose it and it chose me back. A man who commits to a color commits to a world. Everything in the world either belongs to the color or it doesn't. What doesn't belong is left outside. This is not exclusion — it is coherence. The artist who will not commit to a world has no world to invite you into.

chunks.source: In the voice of Prince × Mozart — speculative
chunks.text: The recording is not the music. The recording is a document of the music. The music happened in the room with the people in it and then it was over and what remains on the tape is a shadow. A very good shadow sometimes. But a shadow. The live performance is the thing. Everything else is evidence.
